prompt: The interior of a rustic establishment features dark wood-paneled walls, a planked floor, and an exposed beam ceiling with prominent wooden beams and two hanging light fixtures. A central round wooden table with chairs, a bottle, and glasses anchors the space, flanked by a large decorative wagon wheel and a wooden chest on the left, and framed artwork with shelves on the right. Bright natural light streams through multiple curtained windows and a saloon-style doorway, contrasting with the warm, dim illumination from overhead fixtures, creating an inviting, aged ambiance.
